title: CVE-2026-8697: Login Rate Limit Bypass on TP-Link Archer C64
description: CVE-2026-8697 is a logic flaw in the TP-Link Archer C64's OS (called TPOS in the debug message). It lets any unprivileged user connected to the router bypass the web UI rate limit by using a residual SSH service. A simple Python script can be used to try out many passwords in a short amount of time and obtain full admin access on the router. CVSS 3.0: 8.8 High
